name: omnilab/itis
description: Omnilab ITIS: a taxon of the Integrated Taxonomic Information System by its TSN or its name - authority, rank, usage and why, accepted name, hierarchy, common names, geographic divisions, jurisdictional origins, credibility rating; parent, accepted name, synonyms and children related - and a search of scientific and common names, through the ITIS JSON web service, no key needed.
